fieldNotes.discount_amount: Capture group 1 = sale price (ב-X ₪), capture group 2 = original price (במקום Y ₪). discount_amount = group2 - group1 (computed in code, e.g. 59.90 - 39.90 = 20.00 ₪). discount_pct stays null because the source publishes absolute ₪ savings, not percentages.
fieldNotes.valid_to: Format DD.MM.YY (e.g. 30.06.26) — must be normalized to ISO8601 (e.g. 2026-06-30) before storage. Two-digit year assumed to be 20YY.
fieldNotes.valid_from: Not published on this page for any sampled card -> always null.
fieldNotes.club_id: Azrieli mall coupons are public (no login wall observed) -> club_id stays null, is_public = true.
fieldNotes.image_url: Each card includes one or two ![alt](url) markdown images (brand logo + product photo). Take the LAST image in the block (product photo) via regex: !\[[^\]]*\]\((/_next/image\?url=[^)]+)\) — prefer the one closest to the ### heading.
fieldNotes.source_url: Use the page URL the block was scraped from (one of `urls`).

benefits.notes: Page is mostly navigational/personalized: 'מועדון לקוחות שופרסל מעניק הטבות אישיות וקופונים אישיים' (individual member-only coupons). The one concrete sample text found ('3 ק"ג בהנחה ... בתוקף עד 02.02.2018') is stale cached content, not a live public listing. No stable repeating block structure for anonymous/public visitors was found -> requires authenticated session to see real benefits. Out of MVP scope; mark as v2 / needs login. Azrieli mall coupons used instead as the validated MVP source.
